name: Vitreous-Carn
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by a nearby asteroid belt. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
the pirate hideout was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
